card.name: MB before q in becquerel units
card.fires_on: The letters "MB" that start the radioactivity unit MBq (megabecquerel), right after a number or a slash in radiopharmaceutical dose and radiation-dose tables. It also fires weakly on a unit like "ha" after a slash.

modes.label: MBq after an activity amount
modes.description: MB follows a number in a recommended radioactivity dose, usually next to mCi.
modes.example: The recommended amount of radioactivity of AMYVID is 370<< MB>>q (10 mCi) in

modes.label: Per-MBq dose units
modes.description: MB follows a slash in dosimetry units such as μGy/MBq or mSv/MBq.
modes.example: y/ MBq rad/mCi μGy/<< MB>>q rad/mCi μGy/
